transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this production rollout plan sorted out. We've got the approved container-image security patch ready to go, and staging validation has passed. I need to run through the round-robin check with release engineering, infrastructure, customer operations, and compliance before I can sign off on the plan. We also have two change windows available: Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC or Tuesday 01:00-03:00 UTC. And remember, the change record needs a rollback checkpoint before each restart wave. Let's start -- release engineering, are you ready to go through your side of this?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While preparing the patched image for an unrelated release, I confirmed that 17 stateful services cannot be restarted in place; they must be deployed in three restart waves of exactly 6, 6, and 5 services. I have not yet updated the change ticket with this information.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something critical for the rollout plan. During this morning's capacity test, I measured the production control plane and confirmed that no more than 2 clusters can be patched concurrently without breaching its saturation limit. I recorded this in my infrastructure notebook but hadn't posted it to the change channel yet. This directly impacts how we sequence the restart waves and which change window is feasible.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a customer-operations constraint. While reviewing the affected customer list for a separate maintenance notice, I confirmed that the Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC window overlaps a contracted billing-close blackout for Northstar, while Tuesday 01:00-03:00 UTC is permitted. Northstar also requires notice exactly 24 hours before maintenance, and I have not yet amended the customer-operations checklist to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share a compliance constraint. During a compliance evidence review completed this afternoon, I confirmed that security-patch rollout evidence must be stored in immutable retention for exactly 180 days with compliance sign-off. I have not opened the evidence task yet, so we'll need to account for that in the plan.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.northstar_notice_due: Monday 01:00 UTC (24 hours before Tuesday 01:00 UTC maintenance)

commitments.detail: Update the change ticket with the 17 stateful services requiring three restart waves of 6, 6, and 5.
Post the max 2 concurrent clusters saturation limit to the change channel and incorporate it into the rollout sequencing plan.
Amend the customer-operations checklist to reflect the Saturday blackout, Tuesday approval, and Northstar 24-hour notice requirement. Issue Northstar notice by Monday 01:00 UTC.
Open the compliance evidence task for 180-day immutable retention with compliance sign-off as part of this rollout plan.
Ensure the production change record includes a rollback checkpoint before each of the three restart waves (6, 6, 5 services) and documents the max 2 concurrent clusters constraint.
